heading: Arrive one way. *Leave another.*
lede: The Magi went home by a different road. Christmas has a way of doing that to people. Here's what your hour with us looks like. Want to know more about who we are? Visit [cccomaha.org](https://cccomaha.org).

panels.title: One hour. The whole story.
panels.text: Carols you know by heart, a moment of candlelight, something for every age, and the story of the night Jesus was born.

panels.title: Wear what you want.
panels.text: Christmas sweater, suit and tie, jeans and a jacket—you'll see all of it. What matters is that you're here.

panels.title: Kids welcome.
panels.text: Every service is family-friendly. If your little one needs to move or make some noise, the Wiggle Room in the Atrium streams the service live. Childcare for ages 3 and under is available on Wednesday at 6 PM and Thursday at 4 PM.

panels.title: Come early.
panels.text: The Atrium is set up with photo spots, coffee, and people to meet. Arrive twenty to thirty minutes early to find parking, grab a drink, and settle in.
